$comment: Tests are DELIBERATELY typechecked here. They used to be excluded, which silently killed every
type-level assertion in a *.test.ts (`satisfies`, `Expect<Equal<…>>`, exhaustiveness checks): they
compiled no matter what they claimed. Emit is not a concern — tsconfig.build.json declares its own
include/exclude (which replace, not merge with, these), so tests never reach dist/.
Do not re-add an exclude for src/**/*.test.ts.
